meta.name: bb-methodology
meta.description: Use at the START of any bug bounty hunting session, when switching targets, or when feeling lost about what to do next. Master orchestrator that combines the 5-phase non-linear hunting workflow with the critical thinking framework (developer psychology, anomaly detection, What-If experiments). Routes to all other skills based on current hunting phase. Also use when asking "what should I do next" or "where am I in the process."

copy.tagline: 引导你完成漏洞赏金狩猎的五个阶段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在进行漏洞赏金狩猎，需要系统化工作流指引。
copy.tagline_en: Guide you through the five phases of bug bounty hunting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are conducting bug bounty hunting and need a systematic workflow guide.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成漏洞赏金狩猎的五个阶段：侦察、映射、发现、证明和报告。它会帮你设定每日目标、选择漏洞类型，并在你卡住时建议下一步行动。
howto.when: 在开始任何漏洞赏金狩猎会话、切换目标或感到迷茫时触发。当你问“接下来该做什么”或“我现在在哪个阶段”时也会激活。

say.text: 我今天要针对登录功能测试IDOR漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会引导你进入侦察阶段，并提示相关检查点。

say.text: 我卡在XSS利用上了，接下来该怎么做？
say.note: Claude 会建议你回到映射阶段或尝试绕过技巧。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through the five phases of bug bounty hunting: Recon, Mapping, Discovery, Prove, and Report. It helps set daily goals, select vulnerability types, and suggests next steps when stuck.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of any bug bounty hunting session, when switching targets, or when feeling lost. Also activates when asking 'what should I do next' or 'where am I in the process.'

say_en.text: Today I want to test IDOR on the login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you into Recon phase with relevant checkpoints.

say_en.text: I'm stuck on XSS exploitation, what should I do next?
say_en.note: Claude may suggest returning to Mapping or trying bypass techniques.
